# The Anchor

> Independent British village pub in Stanwell Moor, Surrey, 7 minutes from Heathrow Terminal 5. Dog-friendly beer garden under the flight path, traditional Sunday roasts, stone-baked pizza and free parking. Rated 4.6/5 on Google.

## Key Facts
- **Address:** Horton Road, Stanwell Moor, Surrey TW19 6AQ
- **Phone:** 01753 682707
- **Email:** manager@the-anchor.pub
- **Website:** https://www.the-anchor.pub
- **Established:** 1751
- **Type:** Independent British village pub and restaurant
- **Price Range:** ££ (mid-range); live menu prices at https://www.the-anchor.pub/food-menu
- **Parking:** 20 free spaces, no time limit while visiting
- **Private hire capacity:** 10 to 150 guests
- **Rating:** 4.6/5 on Google
- **Food Hygiene:** 5-star rating (Food Standards Agency)

## Opening Hours
The bar is open until 10pm every day. The kitchen closes earlier, with last food orders 30 minutes before the kitchen closes. Hours are managed live from our booking system; current times and holiday exceptions are at https://www.the-anchor.pub.

| Day | Bar | Kitchen |
|-----|-----|---------|
| Monday | 4pm-10pm | Closed (no food) |
| Tuesday | 4pm-10pm | 4pm-9pm |
| Wednesday | 4pm-10pm | 4pm-9pm |
| Thursday | 4pm-10pm | 4pm-9pm |
| Friday | 4pm-10pm | 4pm-9pm |
| Saturday | 12pm-10pm | 12pm-7pm |
| Sunday | 12pm-10pm | 1pm-6pm (roast) |

## Distance from Heathrow
- Terminal 5: 7 minutes by car (3.8 miles)
- Terminals 2 & 3: 11 minutes by car
- Terminal 4: 12 minutes by car
- Bus: 441, 442 & 555 to/from Heathrow Central Bus Station
- Also 2 minutes from M25 Junction 14 and 8 minutes from Staines

## Food
- Traditional British pub classics: fish & chips, pies, burgers, bangers & mash
- Stone-baked 12-inch pizzas (gluten-free bases on request)
- Sunday roast: Beef Topside, Pork Leg, Turkey with stuffing ball, Beef & Ale Pie, Chicken & Wild Mushroom Pie, vegan Beetroot & Butternut Squash Wellington, and a Kids Roast
- Sunday roast is walk-in friendly, served 1pm to 6pm. Booking recommended but not required. £10 per person deposit only for groups of 10 or more, deducted from the bill.
- Live menu and prices: https://www.the-anchor.pub/food-menu

## Events
- Monthly Quiz Night: £3 entry, teams up to 6, £25 bar tab top prize
- Monthly Cash Bingo: £10 per book, 10 games, cash snowball
- Music Bingo hosted by Nikki Manfadge
- Live music (free entry) and themed nights
- Karaoke (occasional, when listed)
- See https://www.the-anchor.pub/whats-on for dates

## Private Hire
- Function room and beer garden for 10 to 150 guests
- Corporate events, Christmas parties, milestone birthdays
- Wakes and celebrations of life (private entrance, short notice accepted)
- Christenings, baby showers, engagement and garden parties
- Custom catering, AV (TVs and sound system, no projector), free parking
- Contact: manager@the-anchor.pub

## Unique Features
- Beer garden directly under the Heathrow flight path (plane spotting, aircraft 500-800ft overhead)
- Aircraft overhead roughly every 90 seconds during peak times
- Outside the ULEZ zone (saves £12.50/day)
- Dog-friendly throughout (water bowls and treats provided)
- Free WiFi, pool table, darts
- Live sport on terrestrial TV only (BBC, ITV, Channel 4)
